hero: A small demo I built for Sprinter Health.
disclaimer: Independent demo using example data. Not affiliated with Sprinter Health.
exampleNote: Fake example payer. Not a real Sprinter customer.
problem: Payers and internal teams can disagree on what a completed visit or an overdue member means. Skipped home care shows up too late.
solution: One dbt layer defines each goal, with tests. A payer partner sees only their own rows. This page reads the same goal table the warehouse uses.
chartCaption: Solid line is cumulative completed visits. Dashed line is a straight pace to the quarter goal. The pace line continues after the as-of date.
footer: Independent demo using example data. Not affiliated with Sprinter Health.
